# Release Notes Style Guide

## Structure

- Start with a **Highlights** paragraph written in an enthusiastic, customer-facing SaaS marketing tone (e.g., "We're thrilled to announce blazingly fast...").
- Group bullets under **New Features**, **Bug Fixes**, and **Jira References**.

## Guidelines

- Avoid mentioning internal module names; translate changes into high-level product benefits for non-technical end users.
- Include a "How to Upgrade" SaaS dashboard callout at the bottom of every release entry.
